subject: general
question: Sri Akal Takht Sahib is located within the _________ complex.
solution:
The correct answer is __**Golden Temple.**__

__** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] Key Points__**

__
 
• The **Akal Takht is one of five takhts ( which means "seats of power" ) of the Sikhs.**
 
• It is **located in the Golden Temple complex in Amritsar, Punjab, India.**
 
• The three Takhts are in Punjab: - 
 
 
• **Akal Takht in Amritsar.**
 
• **Sri Keshgarh Sahib in Anandpur.**
 
• **Sri Damdama Sahib at Talwandi Sabo Bhatinda district.**
 
 
 
• The other two of the five Takhts are:
 
 
• **Takht Sri Patna Sahib, Patna in Bihar.**
 
• **Takht Sri Hazoor Sahib at Nanded in Maharashtra.​**
 
 

** [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] Additional Information__**

__
 
• **​​__Patna Sahib**​

 
 
• Takht Sri Patna Sahib** also known as Harmandir Sahib**, is a Gurdwara in Patna, Bihar, India.
 
• It was to **commemorate the birthplace of Guru Gobind Singh,** the tenth Guru of the Sikhs on December 1666.
 
• It was **built by Maharaja Ranjit Singh **(1780-1839), the first Maharaja of the Sikh Empire.
 
 
 
• **Golden Temple**
 
 
• The **Harmandir Sahib, or Golden Temple,** in Amritsar, Punjab, India.
 
• The first **Harmandir Sahib was built in 1604 by Guru Arjan, the fifth Sikh Guru.**
 
• A **central religious place of the Sikhs.**
 
• It is a** symbol of human brotherhood and equality.**
 
 
 
• **Gurudwara Bangla Sahib​**
 
 
• ​Gurudwara Bangla Sahib is** situated in Delhi City.**
 
• Built in the sacred visit of Sri Guru Harikrishna Ji to Delhi.
 
 
 
• **Paonta Sahib**
 
 
• Gurudwara in Paonta Sahib is in the **district of Sirmour, Himachal Pradesh.**
 
• This Gurdwara was** built in memory of Guru Gobind Singh Ji, the tenth guru of Sikhs.**
 
• The** Dasam Granth** was **written here by Guru Gobind Singh Ji.**
